This page documents a [[id:31C868B9-306E-4282-BA8C-07E647021B34][task]] in the [[id:BC5582FB-1648-42F2-9D6A-B6DB6EEBC676][Acme Corporation follow-ups: manual chapter, logo fixes, synthetic feeds]] story. It captures the goal, current status, acceptance, and any notes or results.

* Goal

The Market Data Architecture knowledge doc
(doc/knowledge/architecture/market_data_architecture.org) records
the simulated-data-generation strategy decided 2026-08-12: the two
use cases (consistent world vs. scenario workspaces), system-party
ownership of the sim config, the feed_binding workspace seam with the
Live sentinel default, per-party consumption and per-party realtime
streams, and per-party CRM. The doc becomes the architecture-level
reference for these decisions, complementing the allium spec.

* Acceptance

- The doc covers the two use cases for simulated data and explains
  why each drives a different design.
- The doc records: system-party config ownership (the no-override
  guarantee), one producer per source (the controller dedup is
  correct), per-party consumption and per-party materialization of
  the shared stream, the feed_binding workspace seam (Live sentinel),
  and the per-party republish subject shape.
- The doc states what the workspaces feature will add (per-workspace
  producers, locking, workspace scoping of configs/series) and what
  remains unchanged (producer internals, vendor producers).
- The doc links the allium spec (doc/llm/specs/simulated-market-data-strategy.allium).
